basic_identification.full_title: Coconut Oilcake as Livestock Feed Ingredient — Specification (पशु आहार घटक के रूप में नारियल की खली — विशिष्टि) (Third Revision)
basic_identification.sector_category: Food and Agriculture / Animal Feeds and Nutrition (approved by the Food and Agriculture Divisional Council and finalized by the Animal Feeds and Nutrition Sectional Committee, FAD 05, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

scope.summary: This standard prescribes the technical specifications, chemical and nutritional requirements, packaging guidelines, and methods of sampling and test for coconut oilcake utilized as an ingredient in animal and livestock feeds across India.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Specification (Food and Agriculture / Animal Feeds and Nutrition)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers and mills are highly encouraged to apply for a license to use the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product bags as a certified assurance of quality, safety, and nutritional conformity. Additionally, all packaging, net weight declarations, and labeling must satisfy statutory food and animal feed regulations, making IS 2154 the technical reference for feed raw-material quality audits.

requirements.detail: Mandates that representative samples of the material for assessing conformity to this standard shall be drawn according to the method prescribed in IS 7874 (Part 1).

Establishes a two-tier quality classification based on processing efficiency, designating the feed ingredients as either Grade I (typically modern expeller pressed) or Grade II (typically traditional rotary/ghani pressed).
Moisture content shall not exceed 10.0 percent by mass for both Grade I and Grade II oilcakes, ensuring dryness to prevent hydrolytic rancidity and mould growth.
Crude protein (N × 6.25) must be a minimum of 22.0 percent by mass for Grade I and a minimum of 18.0 percent by mass for Grade II, ensuring high nitrogen content for animal growth.

requirements.requirement_type: Crude Fat / Ether Extract Requirements (Dry Basis)
requirements.detail: Ether extract (crude fat) must be a minimum of 6.5 percent by mass for Grade I and a minimum of 10.0 percent by mass for Grade II. The higher fat limit in Grade II reflects traditional rotary/ghani extraction, which leaves more oil in the cake.
Crude fibre is capped at a maximum of 12.0 percent by mass for Grade I and a maximum of 11.0 percent by mass for Grade II to ensure digestibility.
Restricts acid insoluble ash to a maximum of 1.5 percent by mass for both Grade I and Grade II oilcakes, controlling contamination from soil, sand, and silicates.
The material must be free from harmful constituents, castor cake, castor husk, mahua cake, musty odors, rancidity, and active insect or fungus infestation.
Requires periodic screening to verify that aflatoxin B1 levels are strictly within safe regulatory limits using sampling methods outlined in IS 13427.

To determine compliance with the moisture, protein, or fibre limits of this standard, the final observed or calculated value of any test or analysis must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded value must match the specified limit in this standard.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 2154 : 2014 (Third Revision) is the national Indian Standard specification establishing technical requirements, chemical compositions, and quality-control testing methods for coconut oilcake used as a livestock feed ingredient. Formulated by the FAD 05 Sectional Committee and reaffirmed in 2024, this standard regulates expeller and traditional rotary/ghani oilcakes. It classifies the material into Grade I (min 22% protein, min 6.5% fat, max 12% fibre) and Grade II (min 18% protein, min 10% fat, max 11% fibre) with a strict 10% moisture limit. By mandating sand-free purity (max 1.5% acid insoluble ash), outlawing toxic adulterants like castor or mahua cake, and directing standard testing under IS 7874 Part 1, the standard ensures safe and high-quality livestock feed production nationwide.
